title: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv briefly squawked hijacking code 7500, prompting Israeli Air Force jets to scramble.
text:
A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv briefly squawked hijacking code 7500, prompting Israeli Air Force jets to scramble. "

"It later switched to emergency code 7700 and disappeared from flight-tracking coverage near Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
